color_profile_note: All source PNGs (xcrun simctl io screenshot) carry an explicit sRGB chunk (verified: `sips -g profile` -> 'sRGB IEC61966-2.1'; PIL im.info contains an `srgb` key). These are RAW FILE VALUES reported as sRGB hex with no profile conversion applied — not converted from Display P3.
method_note: 'patch' surfaces: per-channel median over a manually chosen clean rect (rect in original-image pixel space, i.e. already 3x). 'pill'/chip surfaces: pixels in a generous bounding box are quantized (12-unit bins) and clustered by frequency; the dominant cluster is reported as '<surface>.fill', and the most frequent cluster whose Euclidean RGB distance from the fill exceeds 45 is reported as '<surface>.text' (paired in `pairs`). median_confidence 'low' flags a weak/ambiguous cluster (small fraction of the rect) worth a manual look.
